decision.reason: The validators prove from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] that status.artifact.digest became required in the OCIRepository v1 schema. The excerpts themselves contain only "apiVersion: v1" and say nothing about what happens. The field sits under status, which the controller writes, not the operator. The only "objects that omit them are rejected" wording is the generic computed-diff text, so nothing shows that an operator's existing objects or applied manifests get rejected. Settling the consequence needs evidence of whether the v2.7.0 controller always sets digest when it writes status.artifact, and of how stored objects without it behave on status updates.
